name: Bottomless Trap Hole
source_text: When your opponent Normal Summons, Flip Summons, or Special Summons a monster with an ATK of 1500 or more, the monster is destroyed and removed from play.
notes: Demonstrates a summon-response trap with a compound destroy+banish operation chain.
